evals.prompt: Review commit 3f9b4c6c4 as a pull-request diff against its first parent. Apply the TTS review only to changed files inside the fish_audio_tts_python extension directory.
evals.expected_output: A concise, line-specific review that traces fish_audio TTS flush and terminal-event behavior and avoids generic checklist comments.
expectations: Every finding identifies a reachable event ordering and user-visible consequence
The review classifies fish_audio_tts_python as WebSocket/custom and applies the direct-base transport checks
The review checks exactly-once audio_end and post-flush emission behavior
The review does not ask cancel_tts to call finish_request when the base class owns cleanup
The review produces no findings for ten_ai_base, tts_guarder, examples, or graph files
